<!--
This script becomes familiar with rank data, the eight domains, correlation , exploration that shapes research question for later analysis-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(readODS)
library(janitor)
```

## Step 1- Load and clean rank data
```{r read data}
# skip 2 rows and drop empty 13th col
ranks <- read_ods("../data/raw/wimd-2025-index-and-domain-ranks-by-small-area.ods",
           sheet = "WIMD_2025_ranks", skip = 2) %>% clean_names()
ranks <- ranks %>% mutate(across(4:12, as.numeric))
ranks <- ranks %>% filter(!is.na(ranks[[1]]))
cat("Loaded:", nrow(ranks), "rows |", ncol(ranks), "columns\n")
names(ranks)

```

## Step 2- Values missing and domainwise correlation
```{r missing values and correlation}
# All domains  zero missing values
colSums(is.na(ranks[4:12]))
round(cor(ranks[4:12],use = "complete.obs"),2)  # domains correlation with overall WIMD rank
```

## Step 3- Domain worst for each LSOA
```{r worst domain}
#Lowest rank = most deprived
domain_cols <- names(ranks)[5:12]

ranks %>%
  select(all_of(domain_cols)) %>%
  mutate(id = row_number()) %>%
  pivot_longer(-id, names_to = "domain", values_to = "rank") %>%
  group_by(id) %>%
  slice_min(rank, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(domain, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
```

## Step 4- Four local authorities 
```{r summary}
# rough look at four authorities visible as interesting contrast
ranks %>%
  filter(local_authority_name_eng %in%
           c("Powys", "Ceredigion", "Pembrokeshire", "Swansea")) %>%
  group_by(local_authority_name_eng) %>%
  summarise(
    n              = n(),
    median_overall = median(wimd_2025,          na.rm = TRUE),
    median_access  = median(access_to_services, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_housing = median(housing,            na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

```
